title: chore: PostgreSQL 16 migration scripts
author: diana.chen
description:
Migration scripts for the PostgreSQL 13 → 16 upgrade (NEX-189). Includes:
- Schema migration scripts
- Table partitioning DDL for events table (monthly partitions)
- Index creation scripts
- Post-migration verification scripts
- Rollback scripts

Maintenance window: November 3, 02:00-06:00 IST. Approved by Raj Patel (email_06) and Priya Sharma (email_07).

NOTE: A bug in the post-migration index creation script caused NEX-244 (index silently not created). See incident-postmortem-nov10.md and PR #52 for the hotfix. This PR's scripts have since been updated to re-raise exceptions instead of swallowing them.

review_comments.author: kenji.nakamura
review_comments.comment: Rollback plan looks solid. Confirm the 72-hour standby window is in the runbook per Raj's requirement (email_06).
